ROOT CAUSE: 16 API routes use getZAI(). On Vercel, each route
is a separate serverless container. The in-memory queue only
serializes calls WITHIN a container, not BETWEEN containers.
When 2 routes fire AI calls simultaneously, DashScope returns
ResourceExhausted.

FIX:
- Retry delays increased from 1.5s→15s (exponential) to 8-10s (fixed)
  An AI call typically takes 5-15s. 8-10s delay ensures the
  concurrent call from another container has time to finish.
- Proactive jitter (0-500ms) before each call to reduce collision
- Total retry budget: ~40s (fits within Vercel Pro 60s timeout)
- Exclude mini-services/ from tsconfig (unrelated build fix)" class="Link--secondary" href="/freemind25/these-frame/commit/6b73ec30f33c851cafb97343ee5651d3d83930e7">fix(v6): cross-container retry with <p dir="auto"><strong>ThesisFrame</strong> est une application web de type <em>« tout-en-un »</em> conçue pour accompagner les doctorants tout au long de leur parcours de thèse. Elle combine méthodologie de recherche, rédaction scientifique assistée par IA, gestion de références bibliographiques, visualisation de données et préparation à la soutenance.</p>
